conf.description: Zeek / Corelight dns / csv-file (TSV ASCII writer): header-driven tab split (fixed default column order) then logs-zeek.dns@custom-equivalent ECS mapping. Direct route, no guard hop.

conf.comment: Zeek dns.log (TSV/ASCII writer) -> logs-zeek.dns. Splits on tab per the Zeek 6.0/7.0 LTS default dns.log column order (fixed list, see README gap on header-driven parsing). answers/TTLs are set_separator ',' vectors kept positionally aligned and zipped into dns.answers objects per logs-zeek.dns@custom; AA/TC/RD/RA fold into dns.header_flags; C_INTERNET normalized to IN; query lowercased/trailing-dot-stripped before any watchlist lookup. event.dataset=zeek.dns per the route note.

functions.description: discard Zeek ASCII-writer header/meta lines (#separator, #fields, #types, #path, #open, #close, ...) - they carry no event data

conf.code: (function(){var HEADER=["ts", "uid", "id_orig_h", "id_orig_p", "id_resp_h", "id_resp_p", "proto", "trans_id", "rtt", "query", "qclass", "qclass_name", "qtype", "qtype_name", "rcode", "rcode_name", "AA", "TC", "RD", "RA", "Z", "answers", "TTLs", "rejected"];var ARRAY_COLS={"answers": true, "TTLs": true};var vals=__e['_raw']?__e['_raw'].split('\t'):[];for(var i=0;i<HEADER.length;i++){var name=HEADER[i];var v=vals[i];if(v===undefined||v==='-'){continue;}if(v==='(empty)'){v='';}__e[name]=(ARRAY_COLS[name]&&v!=='')?v.split(','):v;}})();

functions.description: split the tab-delimited data line per Zeek's default dns.log column order (id.orig_h etc. renamed to id_orig_h etc. to avoid a dotted raw field name as a path-based target); answers and TTLs are set_separator ',' vectors so they become parallel arrays here - a naive split desyncs them if an answer value itself embeds a comma (e.g. some TXT records), a known Zeek ASCII-writer limitation with no escaping to code around, documented in the README

conf.code: (function(){var ans=__e['answers'];var ttls=__e['TTLs'];if(!ans){return;}var out=[];var ips=[];for(var i=0;i<ans.length;i++){var val=ans[i];var ttl=(ttls&&ttls[i]!==undefined)?Number(ttls[i]):undefined;out.push({data:val,ttl:ttl});if(/^[0-9]{1,3}(\.[0-9]{1,3}){3}$/.test(val)||val.indexOf(':')>=0){ips.push(val);}}__e.dns=__e.dns||{};__e.dns.answers=out;if(ips.length>0){__e.dns.resolved_ip=ips;}})();

functions.description: zip answers with TTLs element-by-element into ECS dns.answers objects ({data, ttl}); type each element so only the address subset (IPv4 dotted-quad or anything containing a colon, i.e. IPv6) populates dns.resolved_ip, per logs-zeek.dns@custom
batch rename of clean 1:1 mapped fields with no value transform
implement every partial/unmapped transform from the data map, set _time from ts, tag event.dataset, then remove the now-superseded raw columns
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
